newsitem.title: JAPAN: DLR WELL-BID VS YEN IN TOKYO AFTER FRIDAY'S TUMBLE.
newsitem.headline: DLR WELL-BID VS YEN IN TOKYO AFTER FRIDAY'S TUMBLE.

text.p: 0120 GMT --*Dollar well-bid against yen at mid-morning Tokyo after nosedive overseas on Friday. Dollar also firmer against other major currencies.
*Japanese life insurers, importers, securities firms and U.S. fund operators detected buying this morning, but offers by Japanese trading firms capped dollar around 115.60 yen.
*"Life insurers were among the aggressive bidders this morning. They are probably buying back dollars after taking profits on the dollar and U.S. Treasuries last week," a European bank dealer said.
